newsitem.title: USA: USWC prods prices flat ahead of holiday weekend.
newsitem.headline: USWC prods prices flat ahead of holiday weekend.

text.p: Wholesale prices for U.S. West Coast products were mostly flat Thursday as trade evaporated ahead of Friday's U.S. Indepedence Day holiday, traders said.
Los Angeles CARB gasoline remained 55/56 cents a gallon with San Francisco prices the same.
Traders reported a deal done at 55.50
Buyers of conventional grade gasoline, for sale in Reno, Nevada, offered to pay 53/54 cents a gallon, also flat with Wednesday, traders said.
Reformulated gasoline, for sale in the metropolitan Phoenix area, was talked one cent below CARB levels,traders said.
CARB diesel in Los Angeles was unchanged around 56.50/57.50 cents.
